sources.title: Joint Model Partitioning and Bandwidth Allocation for UAV-Assisted Space–Air–Ground–Sea Integrated Network: A Hybrid A3C-PPO Approach
Learning-Based UAV Swarm Video Analytics Orchestration in Disaster Response Management

replacements.quote: The experimental environment is configured identically to that of the A3C-PPO framework. Four intelligent terminals are connected to the UAV .

we utilized data collected from a hierarchical UAV configuration, as described in Sect. 3. This configuration operates within a UAV-Edge-Server network and considers various factors such as different mobility models and fleet sizes.

This effort resulted in the creation of 320 distinct video clips. These videos were then processed on a Nvidia Jetson Xavier NX using the YoloV8 model [48] to conduct real-time object detection, providing key confidence data and processing speed.
